Barrientos, Manuel (Vicar General and acting Archbishop)
A.L.S. and Ms. D.S., 5pp. nm. fol. 1772.
Dispensation of second degree of consanguinity for marriage of two Indians, first cousins. They had already three children, and another Indian had once carried the woman off and kept possession of her for a week.
